example_response_snippet: HTTP 200 OK; Content-Type: image/png; binary PNG raster tile saved as tile.png.
resolution_notes: base_url: Corrected. The current official usage instructions specify https://{a|b|c}.tile.opentopomap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png, so the documented concrete base is https://a.tile.opentopomap.org, not the unlisted bare tile host. example: Corrected to the documented a-subdomain XYZ endpoint; a successful request returns a binary PNG tile. Evidence for both: https://opentopomap.org/about#verwendung
